properties.description:
Bulk edge writes keep the semantics of the typed helpers: constrains' contribution, unit and source; governed_by's ruling; authored_by's roles; provides, consumes, allocate and satisfies. The reply names every edge drawn, and each helper's description names the bulk route. Planned by the 2026-09-29 fix program.

BUILT ON A BRANCH, 2026-09-29: reflow2 PR #629 (branch feat/a-bulk-edge-write-keeps-each-helpers-checks); status stays `planned` until it merges. The change record chg:a-bulk-edge-write-runs-each-typed-helpers-own-checks and the check ver:a-bulk-edge-write-keeps-each-helpers-checks are on the branch's export, hung on cap:bulk-forms, because this capability exists only in the live design.

THE SHAPE CHOSEN: `draw_edges`, one tool.
- Each item is {tool, arguments} and runs that helper's OWN body. The 32 typed edge helpers are split into the tool (it takes the lock) and `<helper>_on` (the body), the one code path the tool and the bulk form both run.
- All items run in one atomic batch (DesignGraph::atomically): all or nothing, every failure named, and check_only writes nothing.
- The reply names each edge drawn, subject first.
- Every helper's LISTED description names it, generated from one list.

WHY THE OTHERS LOST (dec:idea-every-typed-edge-helper-has-a-bulk-form-that-keeps-its-checks, not settled):
- (b) as posed, where create_edges routes by edge type, needs a hand-kept map from free props to each helper's arguments. CONTAINS alone has three helpers.
- (c) list-taking helpers would multiply ~32 schemas.
- (d) structure bundles are a larger capture change.
- (a) alone fixes naming only.

MEASURED: naming the form on the router moved five helpers off first place in find_tools, so the sentence is added at list time, like the lessons. The designer's ~173 edge-helper calls in round 1 fit in 1–2 draw_edges calls at the default reply budget.

SHIPPED 2026-09-29 in reflow2 PR #629 (squash 083790e) as `draw_edges`. Each item names a typed helper with that helper's own arguments and runs its shared body; every helper's served description names it. Its change record, chg:a-bulk-edge-write-runs-each-typed-helpers-own-checks, and its passing check, ver:a-bulk-edge-write-keeps-each-helpers-checks (tests/a_bulk_edge_write_keeps_each_helpers_checks.rs, observed failing 6 of 6 on origin/main 449ba2b first), are in main's committed export, NOT in this live store. Structure bundles (option d) are not built.

The status here stays `planned` on purpose: setting it to realized with no passing check in THIS store would be an unproven claim. The live store will reflect the delivery when main's records are folded in (ver:an-overlay-folds-after-a-squash-merge). The live server also still runs 0.74.0.
properties.name: A bulk edge write runs each typed helper's own checks on every edge, replies with the edges it drew, and every typed helper names it
